facts.business: The company is engaged in manufacturing, bleaching, weaving, printing, and selling of cloths of all types, wholesale trading in fabrics, purchase and sale of plots of land, trading in agriculture items, and is in the process of constructing a hospitality business.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The company created a Preliminary Expense Asset for ROC fees paid for increase in authorised share capital in FY2023-24 and FY2024-25 instead of appropriate accounting treatment under Ind AS, and wrote off such asset partially each year; in the current year, management wrote off the preliminary expenses against retained earnings without retrospective restatement of comparative financial information as required by Ind AS 8.

key_risks: Pricing pressure due to opening up of quotas
Rising production cost from increasing wages, power and interest cost
Input costs including power and labour are extraneous factors making it difficult to face competition
Strategic Risk, Business Risk, Finance Risk, Environment Risk, Personnel risk, Operational Risk, Reputation Risk, Regulatory Risk, Technology Risk, Political Risk
